data.name: Tavern & Tombs
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Tavern & Tombs!

In Tavern & Tombs, you play as a brave adventurer delving into dangerous, procedurally generated crypts to face off against hordes monsters. When the dungeon beats you down, return to your cozy tavern to lick your wounds, brew powerful potions, and prepare for your next run!

Key Features

- Action Roguelite Combat: Dodge attacks and cast devastating magic spells (like the fiery Fireball and protective Bone Shield) in real-time 3D combat.

- Procedural Dungeons: No two runs are the same! Explore randomly generated dungeon rooms filled with enemies, traps, and secrets.

- Loot & Upgrades: Defeat enemies to collect Essence and gold. Use them at the Essence Shrine in your Tavern to unlock permanent meta-upgrades.

- Deep Equipment System: Find and equip powerful gear with various stats and rarities to customize your playstyle and build the ultimate dungeon crawler.

- Brew Potions: Manage your inventory and craft powerful alchemical potions to heal yourself or buff your stats for the next deep dive.

- Stylized Dark Fantasy: Experience a beautiful low-poly world brought to life with dynamic lighting and atmospheric environments.

data.short_description: Tavern & Tombs is an action roguelite looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore procedural dungeons, blast hordes of monsters with powerful magic, and collect epic loot. Return to your tavern to brew potions and spend essence on permanent upgrades before your next run into the crypts!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (Vulkan required)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains cartoon fantasy violence. Players use magic spells to defeat fantasy creatures (skeletons, orcs) in dark dungeons. There is no gore, realistic violence, sexual content, self-harm, or drug abuse. Includes themes of alchemy and tavern management.
